instrumentation.ownership: One Phaser constructor observer retains only a WeakRef to the first ordinary game and reads its existing lastPaint.run through authoritativeCheckpoint. No listeners, painter wrappers, scheduling hooks or demo-world references are added.
instrumentation.baseline: Closed after all four modes have played, including persistent host/module initialization and the observer.
instrumentation.CDP: DOMDebugger.getEventListeners on window, document, body and every stable element with an ID in the demo panel, plus ordinary canvases. Node backend IDs filter out descendants. Every root and handler object handle is released after inspection.

limitations: Direct attached-target listeners and explicit owner counters only; detached nodes, browser internals and driver/GPU allocations are not exhaustively measured.
No heap dump, forced garbage collection, video, trace or memory total is used.
Normal initialized host listeners and the originating paused game remain intentionally owned.

source.scope: Principal shared runtime/adapter modules and this probe; full reviewed runtime fingerprint, when supplied, is declared separately.
